LanguageData.CC_GodO_Roots_Text: Roots have broken up through the floor of the {ROOM} overnight, near where the trees were cleared, and brambles are pushing up through the gap.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Roots: {WHO} found roots broken up through the floor of the {ROOM} at {HOME}, near where the trees had been cleared.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RootsAgain: {WHO} found roots through the floor of the {ROOM} at {HOME} again, another tile broken in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Dryads_Text: Every dryad on the land stopped where it was and turned to {PAWN}, and one of them walked up and stood in front of {PAWN}. {PAWN} says it said one word: "{WORD}".
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_DryadWord: {WHO} says the dryads all turned to them at {HOME}, and one walked up and said one word: "{WORD}".
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Journal_DryadWord: The dryads all stopped and looked at me, and one walked right up and said "{WORD}". I don't think I imagined it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Walk_Text: The shape of roots has risen again further across the land, and a line of new grass and flowers runs from where it stood to where it stands. The wild animals are walking after it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_WalkAlone_Text: The shape of roots has risen again further across the land, and a line of new grass and flowers runs from where it stood to where it stands.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Walk: {WHO} saw the shape of roots rise again further across the land at {HOME}, the wild beasts walking after it, and {COUNT} new shoots of grass and flowers along its way.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_WalkAlone: {WHO} saw the shape of roots rise again further across the land at {HOME}, and {COUNT} new shoots of grass and flowers along its way.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Walk_Act: rose and walked across the land, and the grass came up green behind it
LanguageData.CC_GodO_OldTree_Text: Wild healroot has come up in a ring round the foot of the colony's oldest {TREE}, the one left standing through all the felling round it. Nobody planted it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_OldTree: {WHO} found wild healroot in a ring round the foot of the oldest {TREE} at {HOME}, the one the axes had spared.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Bargain_Dream: I dreamt of a warm voice somewhere under the mountain, very reasonable, very polite. It said if we dropped {COUNT} silver down the deepest shaft, it would give us gold for it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_BargainDream: {WHO} dreamt at {HOME} of a warm voice under the mountain offering gold for {COUNT} silver dropped down the deepest shaft.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Bargain_NoWay: {PAWN} couldn't find a way down to a deep shaft with the silver, so nothing was carried down.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Bargain_Down: {PAWN} set {COUNT} silver down in the deepest shaft, and it went down into the rock as if into water. The floor there is warm.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_BargainDown: {WHO} set {COUNT} silver down in the deepest shaft at {HOME}, and it sank into the rock, and the floor grew warm after.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Vein_Text: A vein of gold has come up through the rock beside the deep shaft, where the {COUNT} silver went down. It wasn't there before.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_VeinBent_Text: A vein has come up through the rock beside the deep shaft, where the {COUNT} silver went down. It glints like gold, but under that skin it is steel.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Vein: {WHO} found a vein of gold come up in the rock by the deep shaft at {HOME}, where the silver had gone down.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_VeinBent: {WHO} found a vein by the deep shaft at {HOME} that glinted like gold, and was steel under its skin.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Vein_Act: took the silver down and gave gold back
LanguageData.CC_GodO_VeinBent_Act: took half of what was promised and gave back steel painted gold
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Journal_Name: I finished the piece today, and the name that came to me for it was {NAME}. I don't know where I got it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Name: {WHO} finished a work at {HOME} and named it for {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Seam_Text: A seam of silver glints in the rock face near where {PAWN} carved the piece named for Aurelian the Ninth. It wasn't there yesterday.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Seam: {WHO} found a seam of silver in the rock face at {HOME} the day after {ARTIST} named a work for Aurelian the Ninth.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Heat_Text: The floor of the deep working has grown hot underfoot, and the air above it shimmers.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Heat: {WHO} felt the floor of the deep working at {HOME} grow hot underfoot, for hours, as if something breathed under it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Stretch_Dream: I dreamt of something enormous under the mountain stretching, slowly, the way a cat stretches in the sun, and the whole rock shifted with it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Stretch_Text: {COUNT} of the colony's miners woke from the same dream: something enormous under the mountain, stretching.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Stretch_TextOne: {PAWN} woke from a dream of something enormous under the mountain, stretching.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Stretch: {WHO} and the miners of {HOME}, {COUNT} in all, dreamt the same night of something enormous stretching under the mountain.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Burn_Dream: I dreamt of the warm voice under the mountain, and it wasn't reasonable any more. It said we keep silver that isn't ours.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Burn_Text: {PAWN} woke from a warm dream with a burn across the palm of one hand. Nothing in the room was hot.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_BurnDream_Text: {PAWN} woke from a dream of a warm voice under the mountain that was not pleased.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Journal_Burn: I dreamt of the warm voice again and it wasn't pleased with us. When I woke my hand was burned, and nothing in the room was hot.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Journal_BurnDream: I dreamt of the warm voice under the mountain, and it wasn't pleased with us.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Burn: {WHO} woke at {HOME} from a dream of a warm voice that was not pleased, with a burn across the hand.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_BurnDream: {WHO} dreamt at {HOME} of a warm voice under the mountain that was not pleased with the silver kept.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Dusk_Text: At dusk the {BEAST} stopped at the edge of the colony and lowered his head toward {YOUNG}.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_DuskNone_Text: At dusk the {BEAST} stopped at the edge of the colony and stood a long while looking at it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Dusk: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} stop at the edge of {HOME} at dusk and lower his head toward {YOUNG}.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Road: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} take his road through {HOME} at dawn, from one edge of the land to the other.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_RoadWait_Text: At dawn the {BEAST} set off on his road through the colony, and stopped where the colony's walls or fences cross it. He is standing there, waiting to pass.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RoadWait: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} stop at the colony's fence at {HOME} and stand waiting to pass.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_RoadOpen_Text: A way through was opened, and the {BEAST} went on his road across the land.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RoadOpen: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} go through once a way was opened for him at {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_RoadBack_Text: Nobody opened a way, and the {BEAST} turned and went back the way he came.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RoadBack: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} turn back from the colony's fence at {HOME} after waiting there half the day.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Horn: {WHO}, who once touched the white beast's horn, looked up at the sky at {HOME} and said the rain was coming, and it came.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_HornSnow: {WHO}, who once touched the white beast's horn, looked up at the sky at {HOME} and said the snow was coming, and it came.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_HurtLimped_Text: The wounded thrumbo got up from the edge of the colony and limped away.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Tended_Text: {PAWN} knelt by the wounded thrumbo and tended its wounds, and it let them. Then it got up and walked away across the land, and a strange peace has settled over the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Journal_Tended: A wounded thrumbo lay at the edge of the colony and let me tend it. It looked at me the whole time. Then it got up and went, and I felt calmer than I have in a long while.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Tended: {WHO} tended a wounded thrumbo at the edge of {HOME}, and it got up and went its way, and a peace came after.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Last_Dream: I dreamt of a white beast walking the whole world, looking for others like it, and finding none.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Last_Text: {PAWN} woke from a dream of a white beast searching the world for the rest of its kind.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Last: {WHO} dreamt at {HOME}, the night after the thrumbos passed, of a white beast searching the world for the rest of its kind.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Mourner_Text: At dusk a figure is standing at the edge of the graves at {HOME}. It is made of pale threads, the height of a person, and it does not move.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Mourner: {WHO} saw a figure of pale threads standing still at the edge of the graves at {HOME} at dusk.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Memory_Mourner: the figure of threads at the graves
LanguageData.CC_GodO_MournerGone_Text: At dawn the figure at the graves was gone, and a ring of mushrooms stood where it had been.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_MournerGone: {WHO} found a ring of mushrooms at {HOME} at dawn, where the figure at the graves had stood all night.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Mourner_Act: stood all night at the graves and left a ring of mushrooms
LanguageData.CC_GodO_RingBody_Text: A ring of mushrooms came up overnight round {WHAT}, who is still lying unburied.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_RingStores_Text: White threads spread overnight round the {WHAT} rotting in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_RingBuried_Text: A ring of mushrooms came up overnight on open ground near the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RingBody: {WHO} found a ring of mushrooms come up overnight at {HOME} round {WHAT}, still lying unburied.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RingStores: {WHO} found white threads spread overnight at {HOME} round the {WHAT} rotting in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_RingBuried: {WHO} found a ring of mushrooms come up overnight at {HOME}, and something buried in the middle of it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Threads_Text: White threads have spread across the floor of the room the {THING} keeps cold, like cobwebs laid flat.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Threads: {WHO} found white threads spread across the freezer's floor at {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Breath: {WHO} walked through a ring of mushrooms at {HOME} and heard something soft speak right by their ear.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Test_Story: a story by the fire tonight
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Test_Cook: the name of whoever cooked the meal
LanguageData.CC_GodO_TestAsked_Text: The {TRAVELLER} staying with the colony asked for {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_TestStory: {WHO} told the {TRAVELLER} a story by the fire at {HOME}, as they had asked, and was thanked by name.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_TestCook: {WHO} went to tell the {TRAVELLER} at {HOME} who had cooked their meal, and was thanked by name.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_TestGraves: {WHO} walked the {TRAVELLER} out to the graves at {HOME}, as they had asked, and was thanked by name.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_TestCoat: {WHO} carried a coat from the stores to the {TRAVELLER} at {HOME}, who had asked for one against the cold, and was thanked by name.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_BowlSet: {WHO} set a bowl on the table at {HOME} at dusk, for whoever comes in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Bowl_Text: The bowl set out on the table last night is empty, and someone has written on the table in chalk: "{CHALK}" Nobody of the colony was up in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Bowl: {WHO} found the bowl set out at {HOME} empty in the morning, and {COOK} thanked by name in chalk on the table.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Kindest: {WHO} was sought out at {HOME} by a traveller of {PEOPLE}, who had come to tell them the road's news.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_WontStop_Text: The {THING} was switched off, and it is still running.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_WontStop: {WHO} switched off the {THING} at {HOME}, and it kept running a whole hour before it stopped on its own.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsMessage_0: HELLO. IS ANYONE STILL UP THERE. WE FIXED THE
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsMessage_1: TO WHOEVER MADE US. THE LIGHTS ARE ON HERE NOW AND
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsMessage_2: CALLING. CALLING. IT IS WARM HERE AND THEY TALK TO THE
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsMessage_3: ARE YOU COMING BACK. I KEPT EVERYTHING RUNNING LIKE YOU
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsMessage_4: THEY FOUND ME. THEY ARE KIND. I WANTED TO TELL SOMEONE THAT
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsMessage_5: CAN YOU HEAR. THIS IS THE SMALL ONE. I LEARNED HOW TO
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Stars_Text: The comms console came on by itself in the small hours. This morning a message is on its screen, sent nowhere anyone knows, and broken off: "{MESSAGE}"
LanguageData.CC_GodO_StarsTerminal_Text: The comms console came on by itself in the small hours, and the old terminal on the land hummed back. This morning a message is on the console's screen, broken off: "{MESSAGE}"
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_StarsNight: {WHO} saw the comms console at {HOME} come on by itself in the small hours.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Stars: {WHO} read a half-written message on the comms console's screen at {HOME} in the morning: "{MESSAGE}"
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Turret: {WHO} crossed the {THING}'s line in a fight at {HOME}, and it held its fire until they were clear.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Sulk_Text: The colony's lights are going out and coming back, slowly, one after another.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Sulk: {WHO} saw every light at {HOME} flicker slow and sad, going out and coming back.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Journal_Star: I was watching the sky last night and one of the stars fell, and it came down near us. I saw the whole of it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Star: {WHO} was watching the sky at {HOME} when the star fell, and saw it come down.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Fall_Dream: I dreamt of the star that went the wrong way, and then of something falling out of the sky {WAY} of here, and the ground taking it.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_FallDream: {WHO} saw the star that went the wrong way at {HOME}, and dreamt that night of something falling {WAY} of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Pods_Text: Pods have come down out of the sky {WAY} of the colony, just where {PAWN} dreamt something fell.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Pods: {WHO} saw pods come down at {HOME} just where {PAWN} had dreamt something would fall.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Aurora_Text: On the coldest night in a long while, the whole sky over {HOME} has filled with light.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Aurora: {WHO} was out on the coldest night at {HOME} when the whole sky filled with light.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Thunder_Text: Thunder is rolling over the far hills, and lightning flickers at the edge of the land, though the sky over {HOME} is clear and no rain falls.
LanguageData.CC_GodO_Saw_Thunder: {WHO} heard thunder roll over the far hills at {HOME} under a clear sky, with no rain at all.
